title: Not what you're expecting...not an insulated cup!!
text: Not what you're expecting...not an insulated cup!!. These are reusable but, they are thin plastic and not worth the $ you pay...Wow! Starbucks should not put logo to the cup, without saying it's not meant for HOT drink. Should cost half of the cups you'd buy in the store...these also have a snap on lid, NOT the twist screw lid. Save money and buy cup that actually won't burn your hand with hot content inside...because, this one will. It's plastic sure, but like a thin plastic cup..and as guessed, when full of hot..plastic gets hot!!!

Starbucks Reusable Travel Cup To Go Coffee Cup Grande 16 oz
description: Starbucks Reusable 16 oz Grande Travel To Go Plastic Coffee Cup Tumbler White. These cups are designed to replace paper cups and thus the need to fill landfills with mountains of used paper cups. These cups can be used over and over again but are not designed to take the place of long lasting more expensive travel mugs. Note, just as with paper cups, sleeves or napkins to protect against heat is highly recommended.
